title: Clean entry at a prepared seam
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, let $x$ and $s$ be Boolean words, and let $q$ be a state of $B$. The captured logged seam configuration whose first work tape contains $s$ and whose other work tapes are blank equals the two-ended administrative configuration with state $q$, tape zero containing $s$, the last tape blank, both endpoint heads at position $0$, input head at position $1$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
replaced:
For a machine $B$ with at least one work tape: the clean wrapper's captured entry
configuration at the prepared seam carrying $s$ on tape zero equals the
two-ended administrative configuration with tape zero $s$, blank capture, and
both endpoint heads at zero.
